fixer.title: Cache chat input picker measurements during resize

cases.mechanism: Each ResizeObserver delivery synchronously reran collection-wide picker expansion, geometry reads, deep DOM cloning, clone attachment, and layout measurement, with additional measurement passes for compact/minimal states. The work repeated throughout continuous resizing and multiplied across visible chat panes.
cases.symptom: Continuous native-window or grid-sash resizing incurred repeated synchronous DOM cloning and layout resolution per picker lane, scaling with resize notifications, picker presentations, and visible chat panes and producing resize-frame latency/jank.
cases.fixedBehavior: The new layout path stores intrinsic presentation thresholds in _measurement, computes additional steps only until each bounded presentation is measured once, and then serves subsequent resize widths with fit() plus presentation updates; parent notifications are also coalesced onto animation frames.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, the ResizeObserver callback at line 60 called layout() for every observed size change. The deleted layout path reset every picker to expanded and repeatedly called _fitsAvailableWidth; that helper synchronously read live geometry and called _measurePreferredLayout, which deep-cloned and attached the lane for each presentation tried. The changed tests establish the intended multiplicity by asserting that subsequent width changes add zero cloneNode calls after threshold construction.
